title: Lacson: Call for due process won’t shield Bato dela Rosa from ICC trial

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Panfilo “Ping” Lacson on Tuesday said that his call for due process for Sen. Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa does not mean shielding his colleague from facing trial before the International Criminal Court (ICC). According to Lacson, “due process means allowing Senator dela Rosa to face trial before the ICC rather than risk violence and worse, tragedy.” In a media release, he stressed that due process is a fundamental right that belongs to all human beings, including dela Rosa, who previously served under him in the Philippine National Police and the Presidential Anti-Organized Crime Task Force.
